quote_zh: Synthesis of 2-nitro-4-methylsulphonyl benzoic acid (NMSBA) of formula (III) ... to form precipitated product (NMSBA). The product obtained was filtered and dried at 50°C under reduced pressure to obtain NMSBA as light yellow solid. ... HPLC purity >95%; Yield: 68%; and Melting point: 210-214°C.
acidified to pH < 3 using concentrated hydrochloric acid (54mL, 0.51mol)
